run_generate_fake_oxford_pet_data: run the oxford_iiit_pet module to generate fake training and test images with annotations
run_generate_data_with_custom_dir: run the oxford_iiit_pet module with --tfds_dir flag to specify a custom output directory
test_generate_fake_images: test the _generate_data function to produce 10 fake JPEG images and 10 trimap PNGs
test_output_dir_path: test the _output_dir function to return the expected fake_examples oxford_iiit_pet path
summarize_generate_annotations: summarize the _generate_data function to create trainval.txt and test.txt annotation files
